# Mockifyer — full reference for AI assistants

> Mockifyer records and replays HTTP requests made via axios or fetch. Mock data is stored as JSON files under `mock-data/<scenario>/`. Official site: https://mockifyer.dev

## Packages (install these, not the repo root)

Prefer npm registry versions over hardcoding here.

| Package | Purpose |
|---------|---------|
| `@sgedda/mockifyer-core` | Types, matching, scenarios, dates, activation, AI context |
| `@sgedda/mockifyer-axios` | `setupMockifyer` for Axios |
| `@sgedda/mockifyer-fetch` | fetch, React Native, dashboard proxy |
| `@sgedda/mockifyer-dashboard` | CLI + UI, Redis proxy, client lanes |
| `@sgedda/mockifyer-mcp` | 42 MCP tools for Cursor/Claude — `npx @sgedda/mockifyer-mcp` (goes live once published) |
| `@sgedda/mockifyer-test-helper` | Test utilities (not on npm — build from `packages/mockifyer-test-helper`) |

## Add Mockifyer to this repo

```bash
npx mockifyer-init-ai
```

Installs `docs/mockifyer-ai/` (`INSTRUCTIONS.md` + reference) from `@sgedda/mockifyer-core`.

## Setup (axios)

Initialize **before** importing axios:

```typescript
import { setupMockifyer } from '@sgedda/mockifyer-axios';

setupMockifyer({
  mockDataPath: './mock-data',
  recordMode: process.env.MOCKIFYER_RECORD === 'true',
  useGlobalAxios: true,
});

import axios from 'axios';
```

## Activation modes (Node axios/fetch)

| Mode | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| `always` | Default — all requests use Mockifyer |
| `client_id_header` | Only when `X-Mockifyer-Client-Id` is set |
| `off` | Plain HTTP |

Env: `MOCKIFYER_ACTIVATION_MODE` overrides config.

## React Native startup

`MOCKIFYER_MODE`: `on` (default) | `launch_client` | `manual` | `off` — gates fetch patching at startup via `setupMockifyerForReactNative`. `manual` (aliases: `e2e`, `maestro`, `gui`, `toggle`) enables programmatic control.

## Common environment variables

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `MOCKIFYER_RECORD` | Record real responses |
| `MOCKIFYER_PATH` | Mock data root |
| `MOCKIFYER_SCENARIO` | Active scenario |
| `MOCKIFYER_CLIENT_ID` | Client lane (multi-service / Redis proxy) |
| `MOCKIFYER_ACTIVATION_MODE` | always \| client_id_header \| off |
| `MOCKIFYER_RECORD_NEW_AS_PASSTHROUGH` | New mocks stay on live API until dashboard activation |
| `MOCKIFYER_USE_SIMILAR_MATCH` | Path fallback matching |
| `MOCKIFYER_DATE` / `OFFSET` / `TIMEZONE` | Date manipulation |

## GraphQL

Request keys: normalized query + sorted variables JSON.

## Dashboard & MCP

```bash
npx @sgedda/mockifyer-dashboard --path ./mock-data
npx @sgedda/mockifyer-mcp
```

MCP server (42 tools) includes: `mockifyer_get_mock_ai_context`, `mockifyer_search_mocks`, `mockifyer_set_field_overrides`, `mockifyer_list_scenarios`, `mockifyer_explain_value`, `mockifyer_explain_incident`, `mockifyer_set_mock_behavior` (status/delay overrides), override group tools, Atlas tools, fixture pool tools, and `mockifyer_promote_response`. Use `npx @sgedda/mockifyer-mcp` once published (or build from `packages/mockifyer-mcp` until then).

Dashboard mock API also exposes `/api/mocks/:file/ai-context` for lightweight field/schema projections.

## Request correlation

Outbound headers: `x-mockifyer-request-id`, `x-mockifyer-parent-request-id` for multi-hop tracing.

## Atlas from Playwright E2E

- Playwright config: `e2e/playwright.config.ts` sets `globalTeardown: './global-teardown.ts'`
- Teardown: fetch `GET /api/network-events?limit=10000`, scrub, `buildAtlasDocHtmlFiles` → `e2e/atlas-report/`
- CI: `.github/workflows/e2e.yml` uploads `atlas-architecture` from `e2e/atlas-report/`
- Guide: https://mockifyer.dev/guides/atlas-from-playwright
- Showcase: https://mockifyer.dev/atlas/wanderweird/

## Streaming (SSE / chunked)

Fetch can record `response.stream` timelines (`kind`, timed `chunks`, optional `truncated`) while keeping concatenated `response.data`. Config: `streamReplay` (`accelerated` default | `original` | `immediate`), `streamRecordMaxBytes`, `streamRecordMaxDurationMs`. Recording is direct-mode only; dashboard proxy can replay stream mocks but does not record them yet. No axios `responseType: 'stream'`, EventSource, WebSockets, or gRPC. Guide: https://mockifyer.dev/guides/streaming

## How to mock API calls in React Native

Guide: https://mockifyer.dev/guides/how-to-mock-api-calls-in-react-native — compare stubs, MSW (`msw/native`), local mock servers, and Mockifyer record-replay. Primary path: `@sgedda/mockifyer-fetch` + `setupMockifyerForReactNative` (Hybrid + Metro). Selective recording into `_scratch`; activate via dashboard or domain-path rules. Android emulator dashboard URL: `http://10.0.2.2:3002`. Store builds: `MOCKIFYER_MODE=off`.
